description: Source code for the PageAgentDispatcher class, which manages page agent interactions, event handling, and communication within the Playwright core server.

classes.name: PageAgentDispatcher
classes.description: Dispatcher class for managing page agent operations, including performing tasks, expectations, extraction, and event handling.

methods.name: perform
methods.description: Executes a page agent perform task and updates usage history.

methods.name: expect
methods.description: Sets an expectation for the page agent and updates usage history.

methods.name: extract
methods.description: Extracts data based on query and schema, returning results and usage.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Disposes of the page agent, potentially closing scope and stopping operations.

methods.name: _eventSupport
methods.description: Defines event handlers for conversation turns, tool calls, and errors.
